title: Motor City
overview: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

title: Hana Korea
overview: A young North Korean refugee fights to rebuild her life in fast-paced, hyper-modern South Korea, forcing her to confront the price of freedom and the past she left behind.

title: Black Burns Fast
overview: Black Burns Fast is a queer and quirky coming of age film set in at a prestigious boarding school in South Africa. 17-year-old adorkable Luthando is on track for a normal academic year, until Ayanda arrives at the school and forces her to rethink everything. In the aftermath, Luthando struggles with juggling multiple identities to avoid rejection from her mother and her schoolmates as she comes to terms with her sexuality.

title: Weez-MUTATION
overview: The story of how world-famous band, Dudd, got their powers.

title: Action
overview: When two actors—Luke and Carlo— meet for their last chemistry read, their relationship is changed by the masks they put on, and the scripts they play out.

title: Célosia
overview: A grieving man visits his wife's grave, where a mysterious woman hands him an envelope. He soon finds himself immersed in memories of the past, haunted by the strange stranger he met at the cemetery.

title: EROS
overview: Beatriz is trapped in a vicious cycle where she doesn’t feel seen. All of that changes once she meets Sofia.

title: Vidas Enredadas
overview: When his estranged son returns to confront him with the remnants of the past, an elderly deaf fisherman retreats into silence. However, a final memory forgotten at the bottom of a box calls into question what he believed to have been a sacrifice for his family.

title: François.e
overview: A struggling screenwriter falsely claims to be transgender to get funding.

title: Miss Mermaid
overview: Freshly divorced, Fanny, a thirty-something from Fécamp, has nothing left of her marriage but a sky-blue sofa, debts she refuses to pay, and an absolute determination never to 'start her life' with a man again. Despite her burning need for freedom, this cleaning lady finds herself stuck back at her parents' house.  That is, until the day she crosses paths with Anemone, a professional mermaid passing through the region. She decides to take the plunge and dive into the world of mermaiding.

title: The Guests
overview: A young couple in 1973. Iria is a migrant worker from Spain; Hajo is a student from Germany. When Iria’s mother becomes terminally ill, they decide to leave Köln and take her back to Galicia. Their road trip leads them through a variety of social and political systems that existed in the 1970s, while their relationship comes to reflect the zeitgeist.

title: Strawberry Fields Forever
overview: The year-round residents in a lakeside campsite have to leave because of a sale.

title: Burnt Ends
overview: Ten filmmakers were tasked with making surreal short film segments that loosely involve a cigarette. The result is Lynchian chaos in anthology form - the good ends, the bad ends, the loose ends, and the burnt ends. A sprawling anthology about all things cigarettes.

title: Eternal Disco - The Greatest Hits
overview: ABBA, Michael Jackson, Boney M., Chic, Edwin Starr, Lio and Gloria Gaynor: the biggest stars of the 1970s and 1980s took turns appearing on the German TV programme “Musikladen”.  Here’s a selection of these cult moments to let loose to classic disco hits!

title: Orange Justice
overview: Two bumbling but well-meaning NYPD cops on suspension, Murph and Taylor, are tasked with escorting a disinterested Gen Alpha teen, Lacey, to meet her estranged father in Canada.

title: Pine Hollow
overview: …After uncovering a hidden clue tied to a local treasure, a group of teens embark on a treasure hunt through an unforgiving forest, where each discovery brings them closer to the truth and farther from the lives they knew.

title: Young Washington
overview: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

title: The Bay
overview: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

title: Morte Cucina
overview: Sao, a talented cook, accidentally meets the man who took advantage of her in the past. She sets her revenge plan in motion using her cooking skill to achieve a rather unexpected result.

title: 23 000 Lives
overview: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.

title: Lockbox
overview: A woman puts her life on the line to protect her troubled, enigmatic cousin, Winthrop, who has been targeted and hunted by a powerful supernatural force.

title: Alpha
overview: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

title: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
overview: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

title: Anna, Postmortem
overview: When a young woman is murdered for mysterious reasons, her ghost searches for answers - and revenge.

title: Sonho Estrangeiro
overview: In a future where 75% of humanity lives in a virtual reality and the rest remains on an abandoned Earth, an artificial intelligence is unable to recreate images of the physical world. Helena, one of the few people still living outside, is called upon to teach the machine what it cannot comprehend: reality.

title: Petaka Gunung Welirang
overview: Five friends camp on Mount Welirang. On their way to the summit, they encounter a Queen and her royal troops. What mysteries lie hidden within Mount Welirang?

title: The Odyssey
overview: Based on the Ancient Greek epic. After ten years of war, King Odysseus sets sail for Ithaca, eager to reunite with his beloved. But his journey home is far more treacherous than the battlefield, as he must face deadly monsters and vengeful gods to survive.

title: Helena
overview: Helena, the only hilot in a small town who secretly has affairs with her patients' husbands. After a pregnant patient dies upon discovering Helena's affair with her own husband, the enraged townsfolk turn against her.

title: Wings of Dread
overview: Air police officer Gu Chaoyang encounters a hijacking crisis on his flight back to China. With his extremely high professional ethics, he fights desperately to stop the hijacker, and a life-and-death struggle that takes place at an altitude of ten thousand meters begins.

title: Night of the Living Dead
overview: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

title: Satluj
overview: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

title: Man of War
overview: When an aid worker vanishes in the first hours of war in Ukraine, a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative crosses into the shattered country to bring her home-facing mercenaries, shifting battle lines, and ghosts he thought he left behind.

title: Keep Real
overview: Thirty years ago, the Super Ying Association led by Superman Wang Changhai crushed the aliens. Years later, Wang Changhai was appointed to return to his hometown to set up a combat squad, but in the town of Rheinland, which had been peaceful for many years, human feelings and courtesies have left Wang Changhai overwhelmed, creating layers of obstacles to Wang's ability to complete his mission.

title: Simpsley
overview: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she’s tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner’s clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.

title: Aroopi
overview: A vengeful Yakshini, once sealed inside a doll at the Aryanattu estate, is accidentally unleashed by two thieves. When a brutal murder draws Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the lineage, back to his ancestral home, he must confront an ancient curse and the dark secrets surrounding his family's past.

title: Discman
overview: A man goes through a neverending routine in order to abtain perfection.

title: The Gang
overview: Ayman, a teenager of Moroccan descent, is invited by Sara to a party at the same house where his mother works as a domestic worker. Along with Eric and Robert, his lifelong friends, they set off on a journey filled with confrontations and disappointments -with society and with themselves- putting their gang's friendship to the test. Once at the party, they discover that life isn't what they thought, and that wanting something doesn't always make it possible.

title: Quaternité
overview: An experimental film, developed from an interactive installation and composed of 64 episodes. Its structure is based on coin tosses and the ancient Chinese "Book of Changes," where chance determines the order of events, editing, and the very logic of the narrative. The film follows the journey of several people through different spaces, the flow of unpredictable events in their lives, and the unexpected intersections of their destinies.

title: Next Step
overview: Trista and Ellis are a young couple, but their relationship is tested when Trista is suffering from an illness that changes her daily life. Ellis refuses to let her face it alone.

title: Summer's Last Resort
overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

title: Graamaayana
overview: In a rustic village, young Seena earns his "Sixth Sense" nickname through remarkable intuition. His journey through community conflicts, romantic entanglements, and family bonds reveals the essence of rural existence.

title: 9 Moons
overview: Ángel is a personal trainer who, after taking a year off, has just landed a job at the most prestigious gym in the city, and life finally seems to be back on track. But everything changes when he begins to feel unwell, goes to the hospital, and receives shocking news: he’s pregnant. A trans man on the verge of completing his transition, Ángel is now confronted with a life-altering decision—one that will challenge his identity, his aspirations, and his very understanding of masculinity.

title: In the Darkness of Water
overview: Mauro Morandi has lived isolated from society for 30 years on Budelli, an italian island. He is now 83 years old and, despite his advanced age, he is concerned about caring for and preserving the island's nature. One day he discovers that he will be evicted. At the same time, someone contacts him and encourages him to abandon this lifestyle and return to society. Both factors will have repercussions in Mauro's life, who, certainly disturbed, will have to deal with the conflict and assume the possibility of leaving his beloved island, with which he has a truly special connection.

title: Palace Detroit 313
overview: A skate video by Palace, filmed in Detroit over a seven-year period (2018–2025).

title: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
overview: From a lonely childhood to literary fame, her life was shaped by devotion to nature, paying attention, and the long journey toward learning to love and to be loved.  If poetry had a pop icon, Mary Oliver would be it.

title: Eve
overview: While visiting her father's apartment, a woman discovers that the man who raised her might be something less than human.

title: Unidentified Murder
overview: Alien Alert!!! An influencer couple staged a harmless prank in pursuit of clicks and likes. Little do they know, their little escapade has gone out of control and spiraled into a real tragedy. A series of accidents, followed by blackmails and Extraterrestrial Encounters somehow echo and unveil the myth of a myterious child disappearnace 25 years ago! A group of five, a chain of bizzare events, layers of schemes and plot twists. It's all-you-can-experience in One Crazy Night!

title: Solitaire
overview: A young woman adjusts to life in a new city, managing remote work, a relationship on thin ice, and single-player tennis.

title: Watch Out, Kid
overview: A young man is drawn to a handsome guy, but his insecurities stand in his way.

title: Mizandrika
overview: After waking up next to a lifeless body, Drika, a trans woman, revisits her past in search of her freedom. The experimental short film guides us through the thoughts and anguish of a woman who murdered a man.

title: The General
overview: July 4th, 1976. Two hundred years after the signing of the Declaration of Independence, America has changed a lot. Far removed from the original ideals are some individuals. The youth becoming more and more opposed to the "freedom" promised, while others use their power for their own personal gain. It's enough for the Founding Fathers to be rolling in their graves, literally.

title: Le miracle
overview: After Angelica is disturbed by her adult son Mattia in her relaxation bath, she is finally able to let go. She begins to masturbate in front of the poster of footballer Valenti, her son's idol. Suddenly, Valenti's gaze fixes on her… a cry for help. An absurd euphoria spreads: the miracle crystallises into a struggle for power and intimacy between mother and son.

title: Brón
overview: Nineteen-year-old Sersha Cleary is struggling with adulthood and mental illness when she experiences a harrowing coincidence. Three knocks and a bone-chilling scream hours before her grandmother passes. The signature of a banshee an Irish myth her grandmother told her stories about when she was little. After her grandmother passes Sersha finds herself alone and struck with intense grief, fighting with her family and struggling with her everyday life. Amongst her struggles she finds herself haunted by a banshee unable to escape its grasps.

title: The Waiting Man
overview: In 2022, the famous streaming group TOMNI was at the height of its popularity with over 7 million followers. Over the course of a week, their content changed and then they suddenly vanished. This is the footage recovered from their social media, computers, and SD cards. Experts believe the footage shows the worldwide phenomenon known as Alikabiha, also called the Waiting Man.

title: One Piece Heroines
overview: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

title: Popeye III: Requiem
overview: When a covert research team imprisons Popeye to harness his superhuman strength as a military weapon, their experiment spirals violently out of control. Transformed into an unstoppable force driven by rage, Popeye tears through the facility, leaving destruction in his wake. With time running out and casualties mounting, one scientist risks everything to stop the monster they created - before he reaches the outside world.

title: Crossroads
overview: A man attempts to cross the street before his time.

title: Boy
overview: While housesitting alone, Danny invites an older stranger over for a casual hookup. The charged encounter pushes Danny out of his comfort zone and into a world of confusion, forcing him to face the mismatch of who he is and who he appears to be.

title: Petty Thieves
overview: Rio, an introverted young man, tries to make a living for himself by commiting petty theft in restaurants and resorts around the Croatian coast. His life, however, drastically changes when Andrea, a young Serbian part-time worker, enters his life, with the two becoming partners in crime, planning a major heist of two wealthy women staying at the hotel Andrea works at.

title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.

title: Jockstrap
overview: A new purchase opens the door to sexual liberation.

title: Fire Tornado
overview: A dysfunctional rehab group is stranded at a rundown cabin as a roaring firenado melts everything in its path. With roads gone and heat rising, the misfits must combine their strange skills to fortify the house and survive the firestorm’s return.

title: Newsrot
overview: A lacklustre news broadcast gets hijacked by a series of unrelated clips.

title: INDIGO
overview: Can love only come from others? Or can one find that to love, and to be loved, can come from the same person…

title: Our House
overview: Three estranged siblings reunite at the family home for their late mother’s wake, prompting an inheritance battle that turns deadly.

title: Paris Paris
overview: Three men—from China, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Palestine—live together in a squatted apartment in a seemingly abandoned building in Paris. The group is bound together by their shared experience of life in exile and the fleeting nature of their possessions, relationships, and sense of home, but the temporary safe space is threatened by outside forces and events.

title: Anhedonia
overview: Two teenagers meet one last time before one of them returns to the countryside she so deeply despises. She takes solace in the promise that her lover will soon come to visit her there. Trapped in darkness, she can do nothing but wait. Time passes—and even after death, her tormented spirit lingers earthbound, longing for the moment the two may finally be together again.

title: Last Viewing
overview: A sleazy film director hires out a ramshackle cinema to screen his forgotten masterpiece, only for the film to be haunted.

title: Cashcade
overview: A burglar on the run accidentally leaves a trail of cash that leads a homeless man into an unexpected discovery.

title: Backrooms Bigfoot
overview: Two strangers wake up, trapped in the endless backrooms and are hunted by a massive supernatural Bigfoot creature lurking in the maze. As reality breaks around them, they must fight to survive and find a way out before it kills them.

title: The Hoodoos
overview: When a crew of criminals attempts to steal cursed Confederate gold from a haunted Louisiana plantation, they discover that the voodoo protecting the treasure is terrifyingly real… and the dolls are awake.

title: The Incentive
overview: A young journalist and a convincing cameraman plot to film interviews without their company's permission.

title: Fumaça Fotogênica
overview: A young man reflects on his father's vices and memories while dealing with his desire to belong.

title: Farm House
overview: House sitting can be relaxing, peaceful and refreshing, but terror is here to stay. This Warren County Serial Killings Cases is just one of the most perplexing and tragic chapters in the recent American criminal history.

title: Before America
overview: Before America is a cinematic documentary uncovering the Indigenous histories of Michigan long before the United States existed. From the 1763 uprising at Fort Michilimackinac to Odawa trail trees and the overlooked women of Fort Detroit, the film reveals how Anishinaabe nations shaped Great Lakes history and helped spark the chain of events that ultimately pushed the American colonies.

title: Трудные папы
overview: Katya is smart, modest and diligent, but most importantly, she is very convenient for those around her, which they take advantage of. After the death of her overprotective mother, Katya inherits her mother's late lover Andrey Nikolaevich, who has nowhere else to live, along with the house. However, this is not our heroine's main problem. The secrets that her mother hid from Katya during her life, the mortgage debt, because of which she could lose her home, and the mysterious man to whom her mother has been sending large sums of money for many years - Katya will have to figure all this out, and for the first time in her life - on her own.

title: Marave
overview: It follows Manolo, a gentle, naive fairground worker. When their father gets sick, Manolo reunites with his older brother Georges, a con man who abandoned the family twenty years ago. Desperate to prove he is not a failure, Georges schemes to turn the physically strong Manolo into an MMA (Mixed Martial Arts) champion.

title: Yayo
overview: Dana and Lydia are facing a serious trust issue in their relationship. After an argument that threatens to tear them apart, Lydia decides to accompany Dana to her grandfather’s house, where his wife has just passed away. There, the elderly man, driven by despair, becomes possessed by a demonic force and begins to hunt them down. Together, they must resolve their differences and learn to trust one another in order to survive.

title: The Leaching
overview: After waking up on her father's isolated forest property with amnesia, Vivian must use her limited memory to piece together the nightmarish truth, all the while being tormented by the undead, a giant leech monster, and her "father."

title: Retrograde Battlefield
overview: It centers on a Chinese People's Volunteer Army unit during a past conflict that, despite orders to retreat, embarks on a dangerous mission to re-enter the battlefield and fight to protect their homeland

title: Ось
overview: Shy security guard Anton secretly watches the rehearsals of the talented musician Tanya and dreams of one day performing on stage alongside her. His daily life is spent among indifferent people and routine, until one day he discovers he has the ability to telekinesis. But even with his superpowers, Anton faces the reality that the world still remains completely indifferent.

title: Five Years, Four Months
overview: Martha (45), a mother who lost track of her son due to the conflict, receives the news that there was no bone concordance in the last exhumation she participated in. Exhausted of the institutional channels, she turns to a group of women searchers and meets Sandra, who tells her a rumor: “in a remote village on the flatlands of Colombia, you can request a favour from a dead person”. Together with Sandra, they embark on a journey in search of answers, blurring the line between the living and the dead. Mothers searching for their children, children searching for their mothers: two sides of the same scourge converge in search of peace.

title: La chaleur
overview: It’s unusually hot on the beaches of the Landes, and 17-year-old Marouane is spending his last day at the campground with a nagging fear: will the body he buried on the beach the day before be discovered? Marouane also wonders if he might be falling in love with the charming Giulia.

title: Carnal Inferno
overview: The tale of Mark Benway, a boxer who takes a punch that sends him into a world no man wants to go and one that he may never leave.

title: Blog
overview: Fedya is a failed business psychologist. During one of his training sessions, while intoxicated, he makes a scene and becomes a laughing stock in the eyes of those around him. In his blog, Fedya broadcasts the "secrets of success," but he himself has long lost control of his life. His daughter Sonya is a withdrawn, problematic teenager. After her mother's death, an insurmountable wall grew between her and her father, and her grandfather took upon himself the girl's upbringing. After a fight with her peers, Sonya risks ending up in a penal colony - to avoid punishment, she is sent to a summer correctional program at a provincial school. Fedya goes with his daughter: to look after her and at the same time work as a school psychologist until the information noise around his name dies down. There is one summer ahead that can change everything.

title: Братья
overview: At summer camp, eleven-year-old Dima is used to protecting his older brother, Semyon, a teenager with special needs. After a humiliating conflict with their peers, the brothers head into the forest, where they must confront their own fears, resentments, and unspoken love for each other. This is a story about growing up, the fragility of family ties, and the search for intimacy in a world that isn't always willing to accept those who are different.

title: Mirage
overview: Mirages have been reported along the Spanish coast. A young French woman travels to San Sebastián to observe these visual aberrations. There, she meets a mysterious Portuguese woman who tells her a story from her youth: of obsession, and a gaze that can turn the world inside out.

title: Hospital Británico
overview: A man leaves the hospital. He sets out on a journey, perhaps a final one. Alongside the mystical landscapes drift the verses of Hospital Británico (1986), the last book by Héctor Viel Temperley. And the words of those who have been marked by reading it over the years.

title: Staubwelt
overview: An elderly crime investigator has reached the end of her career. Shortly after stepping down, she encounters the Devil, who has appeared in the city and begun working as a police photographer. During a series of walks together, a warmth develops between them. Over the course of their conversations, the Devil reveals he needs her help to end his own existence.

title: Hijamat
overview: Fifty-year-old Murad’s life is shaken to the core when he learns that his younger brother is gay. Murad would like to support his brother, but their traditional Muslim family is against it. As a result, he finds himself subjected to pressures from all sides – from his father, who has close ties to the local imam, and from his brother’s circle of friends as well. He would like to help everyone, but as he slowly falls into a spiral of conflicts and mounting difficulties, he finds that he, too, is in need of help. Another integral part of this family drama is the theme of migration and dialogue – not just between different religions, but within communities themselves.

title: Moana
overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

title: Infiltrate
overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: Nothing to Lose
overview: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

title: Murder Game
overview: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

title: Peace, Peace!
overview: An hour before their mother's funeral, three siblings are forced to reckon with the horrifying reality of their childhood.

title: Uma Princesa
overview: Ten years in the life of Helena Verkoff, according to some of her biographers.

title: Foufo
overview: The encounter of Madurese residents with small aliens that triggers hilarious chaos and unexpected adventures.

title: The Egotist
overview: Poor and tired, Amaro finds himself in the need of moving. Along the way he takes part in conversations that make him reflect on his changing position in society and on the anxieties of a young adult.

title: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy - The Movie
overview: After the Sino-Indian war, a highly trained Indian spy enters Pakistan on a mission to gather crucial intelligence and stop Pakistan from launching an attack against India. Will he succeed?

title: Neon Banana
overview: A seemingly innocent online interaction quickly turns precarious.

title: Home Stories
overview: As a contestant in a singing casting show, Lea is asked by the TV team who she is and what makes her special. She doesn't know and begins to slip into different roles in her search for what makes her special, developing an unexpected fascination for her aunt Kati. Kati's return home as head architect for the renovation of the Residenzschloss after many years abroad reunites the family in one place. This reunion raises the hopes of grandparents Friedrich and Christel that they can join forces to give their pension, which has few visitors, a new lease of life.

title: Election Day
overview: On the election night that will decide her political fate, MP Renata Innocenti sees her career teetering on the brink of ruin when her partner becomes the center of a massive media scandal. Amidst family tensions and political chaos, Renata must fight to save everything she has built.

title: Az Zeeb
overview: The filmmaker, a Chilean of Jewish and Palestinian descent, discovers Super 8 reels belonging to his father’s family. Between Chile, Israel and Palestine, he reconstructs two trajectories shaped by displacement and exile. A lesson in history in which clarity emerges from political complexity.

title: Korean Haunted Hospital
overview: A group of Indonesians: Juna, Adit, Bara, Arum, Yuri, and Tyas set out to live-stream a test of courage at the so-called most haunted hospital in South Korea, Yong-Won Hospital. Rumor has it that the hospital was once a front for a cult whose members chose to die following their leader. Now, the hospital is in a state of disrepair and no one dares to enter. This motivates Juna and his friends to become the first people to live-stream there.

title: Трасса «Море — море»
overview: A red convertible is speeding from St. Petersburg to Sochi, driven by the brazen photographer Tyoma. With him are his ex-wife, Sasha, and her new fiancé. Tyoma will do anything to prevent Sasha's new wedding. And the fatal hitchhiker Kira, rescued by the guys, will help him. Tyoma has only one way across the country to change and win back the love of his life-if his brakes don't fail.

title: Macha
overview: Dismissed after surgery for endometriosis and left without answers,Ana draws on the strength of Macha to reclaim her voice and confront the system ignoring her pain, while her father grapples with the helplessness of loving someone he cannot heal.

title: Shush, Now
overview: A seven year old girl discovers her mum is having an affair.

title: Babesmilk
overview: After an ice cream outburst gets her arrested, an entitled woman grapples with the wreckage of her own behavior.

title: Bump
overview: An expectant mother's world fractures as she obsesses over what her child's future might cost the planet - and what the planet might cost her child.

title: Sludge
overview: Sinead Murphy’s debut film, Sludge, follows a young homeless woman living on the fringes of Irish society and deeply in love with her best friend. Haunted by fractured traumatic memories and visions of a dark-hooded figure, she struggles to hold onto reality as her friend is drawn into the orbit of a dangerous underworld. As her world unravels, she must confront the terrifying truth behind the figure that stalks her, and face the darkness within.

title: I, Nobody
overview: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

title: Urchins
overview: Follows a college freshman as they embark on a road trip with new friends, finding a renewed life purpose.

title: Bad Luck
overview: A suicidal taxi driver must confront his own mortality when he finds himself complicit in the attempted murder of a diabetic cat

title: Pemikat Jiwa
overview: Jay uses a forbidden love potion to make Wulan love him. However, the ritual instead binds Wulan's soul to a supernatural force that threatens her life, forcing Jay to face the horrific consequences of his actions.

title: Evil Dead Burn
overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

title: The Isolate Thief
overview: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

title: Siping
overview: A gripping story about a woman wagered in a high-stakes card game. But the stakes get even hotter when she’s won by the man who’s long been obsessed with her.

title: Idhayam Murali
overview: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

title: Lenin
overview: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence.

title: Night Nurse
overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass

title: Sihir Tanah Kubur
overview: After his mother's death, Yusuf is shocked when his younger brother, Ashar, moves her grave due to a mysterious will. The appearance of the Wurung Tomb triggers a mystical terror that divides the family and the villagers. Amidst the escalating conflict, dark family secrets are revealed, posing a demonic threat that jeopardizes their future.

title: The House
overview: For decades, Gabriel García Márquez envisioned a novel titled La Casa (The House), inspired by the home in Aracataca where he lived with his grandparents. Fragments emerged, but it was only after living in another house —in Mexico City— that he was able to develop the work that became Cien años de soledad (One Hundred Years of Solitude), his magnum opus. In this documentary directed by Eva Villaseñor, the writer’s sons, Rodrigo and Gonzalo García Barcha, return to their childhood home—a place where memory transforms time.

title: Dream High
overview: A cinematic rock opera and an homage to teen films, adapted from the stage musical with the same name by Amit Ulman, scripted completely in Hebrew rhymes. Yoav, a teenage boy who lives with his single mother, who struggles to finance them, moves to a new city. He joins Magshimim High, where words hit harder than punches, and your rhyming skills determine the food chain. After the "class king" demolishes him in a rap battle, Yoav is determined to prove himself and win the heart of the "class queen", Maya. He encounters Hamorabi, a legendary former rapper who hides under the image of the school's kiosk cashier. With his help, Yoav turns from an outcast to the Star of the Battles. But as he climbs high, he draws apart from the friends who stood by his side, the girl who really saw him when no one else had, and the authenticity taught to him by Hamorabi. In the National Rap Championship, Yoav will have to choose between chasing the shining lights of fame or staying true to himself.

title: Semeei Vermelho
overview: Teresa, a Catholic girl, is torn between the desire she thinks she feels for Maria, her long-time friend, and her faith, which she is no longer sure she has. Teresa is increasingly consumed by the world around her, by her confirmation dress and by the moment that is brewing in this closed space: the confession of her sin.

title: Free Wifi
overview: Davi, an online motorcycle taxi driver, fakes a wealthy image on social media to attract Grace's attention. Their relationship is opposed by Grace's ex-fiancé, who hires a detective to uncover Davi's true identity. The revelation of the truth triggers a series of misunderstandings, conflicts, and chaos involving both families.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

title: Her Private Hell
overview: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

title: The Truthers
overview: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

title: Euphoria: A Look Back
overview: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

title: Make Zhonghe Great Again
overview: After encountering a standout colleague from a company event, Liu Ben, a section chief at Zhonghe Group's branch, embarks on a quirky professional journey with him, uncovering their true self-worth through chaotic workplace challenges.

title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
overview: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

title: Moms Guardian
overview: When the mom who abandoned her passes away, Victoria must confront her feelings about the situation when someone unexpected shows up. Her mom's guardian.

title: Asesino Perfecto
overview: A peaceful town is gripped by fear when a series of mysterious murders leaves investigators with no witnesses, no evidence, and no clear suspect. As each new victim is discovered, Captain Rocio Cortes and Detective Soto race to stop a killer who always seems one step ahead. Their investigation uncovers hidden secrets, broken family ties, and painful events from the past that connect several lives in unexpected ways. As suspicion shifts from one person to another, two brothers, Leo and Elias, find themselves at the center of a mystery that will test their loyalty and force them to confront the truth. With fear spreading throughout the community and trust quickly fading, the search for justice becomes a dangerous race against time in this suspenseful Mexican crime thriller filled with mystery, psychological tension, and unexpected twists.

title: Kubana
overview: In Rwanda, KUBANA explores, through stories and silences, how a society chooses unity and coexistence, offering a poetic and political look at living together.

title: Haunted Heist
overview: Four estranged friends reunite at what appears to be a typical house, But one friend has ulterior motives; he plans to rob the place and needs their help to find an antique worth a fortune. But the house is straight up haunted, and the group must squash their differences to survive the night and an insane pack of ghosts.

title: Last Night
overview: Strangers Arun and Tam meet on a rooftop the night they both intend to end their lives. When Arun suggests they spend the night together instead, just until sunrise, they embark on an unexpected journey through the city.

title: Ishqnama
overview: Set in the early 1980s along the India-Pakistan border in Punjab, the story follows Nimma, a young Sikh student and poet from Indian Punjab, who falls deeply in love with Nasima, a Muslim girl from Pakistani Punjab.

title: On the Sea
overview: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

title: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi
overview: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.

title: Pura Vida
overview: 8 delegates set off for an all-expenses-paid Eco convention, in one of the worlds most exotic locations. But fantasies of sun, sea and salsa come crashing down when dreams turn to nightmares full of crocodiles and murder.

title: Justice
overview: The online child safety taskforce, "Predator Puncherz", document their latest and most infamous sting operation.

title: Eiga Kamen Raidā Zettsu Sayonara no Misshon
overview: Baku Yorozu/Kamen Rider ZEZTZ is accused of terrorism by the National Public Safety Commission. Convinced of his innocence, Kensei Odaka/Kamen Rider NOX pursues the true culprit, and finally tracks down the mastermind behind it all, National Public Safety Commission Chairman, Shuma Kumon/Kamen Rider Mugen.

title: Road Head
overview: A young man tries to get his driver's license to fulfill his lifelong dream.

title: Tera Yaar Hoon Main
overview: Sanju moves from Nagpur to Mumbai for work and stays with his late mother's friend Viswanath. He falls for Viswanath's daughter Anu, but her marriage is arranged with another man, leaving Viswanath caught between friendship and fatherhood.

title: Chennai Love Story
overview: Two young people navigate their first experience of love, dealing with its powerful emotions and obstacles while discovering the delicate nature of newfound romance.

title: Eclipse
overview: On the day of a solar eclipse, Ramiro accompanies the parents of his best friend to their house outside the city. During the visit, the son’s absence, while on exchange abroad, becomes evident and places him in an uneasy position.

title: Sound Across the Ocean
overview: The film recreates the situation as the struggle against French colonialism from 1945 to 1954. Tam is a young woman who plays Vietnamese traditional one-string zither and sings Xam folk songs. After helping a revolutionary soldier, her grandfather is shot dead by the enemy. Tam follows the revolutionary path, taking on the mission to Con Dao Island as a doctor to treat prisoners and work with the revolutionary organization.

title: Triple Decker
overview: Over the course of one bizarre day, a couple with a dangerous plan and a stranger with her own agenda find their lives colliding in the most unexpected ways. As secrets simmer beneath the surface, everything quickly spirals into a wild mix of chaos, dark humor, and perfectly timed misfortune—where every move only makes things worse.

title: Outback Dale
overview: After a social media meltdown, a middle aged man embarks on a wild journey to restore his reputation.

title: Bushe
overview: Marta, a lovesick 15 year old, pines for a local boy named Karlo. As the traditional local carnival approaches, its mystical atmosphere and mask making tradition will take her on a personal journey where she will discover the true meaning of her identity.

title: Indrajaal
overview: A legendary treasure hidden during colonial times reappears every 12 years during a solar eclipse. Treasure hunters race to find it but become caught in an ancient prophecy, leading to a gripping tale of ambition and survival.

title: Sour Minnows
overview: Two friends stumble upon an unusual sight: six men sensually licking the pavement on an empty L.A. street. For Ricky, this moment ruptures something. As reality grows porous and memory begins to slip, a delirious new logic takes hold.

title: Due West
overview: A small-town woman in need of medical care in West Texas is forced to break the law.

title: Hot Spot
overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

title: GROTESQQQUE
overview: Anthology film made up of 3 separate segments: Æliens, 4649Girl, and Nocturn: En Cette Nuit Grotesque.

title: 72 HOURS
overview: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

title: Breakfast
overview: On the cusp of a big announcement, a frazzled mom prepares a glorious breakfast for her family. But, when they run for the door before even sampling her buffet, Mom takes matters into her own hands - holding them hostage until every scrap of food is gone.

title: Folkloric
overview: Pequi is an awkward saci who believes he's unlucky for having been born with his left foot. To fix this, he sets off on a fun adventure through the Folclórica forest with his friend Teobaldo and the brave curupira Ingá. Along the way, they face challenges and encounter magical creatures from Brazilian folklore.

title: The Oak Park Post
overview: Two journalists investigate the acquisition of their newspaper and its ties to the murder of their friend and colleague.

title: Kado untuk Ibu
overview: Faris, a firefighter expecting his first child, cancels his trip to the hospital to be with his wife because he has to help Ara find a birthday present for her mother. Their journey becomes an exciting adventure that teaches many good deeds and the meaning of unexpected loss.

title: Sensai
overview: A nymph who longs for the sky sets out to craft the dress that will turn her into a star, transforming her insecurities into creativity.

title: Reaper Road
overview: Two friends end up on a never-ending road that leads into the woods, trapping them in a hellish dimension.

title: PITSTOP
overview: A chance encounter at a gas station opens the doors to love and loss in this arthouse performance piece.

title: Congé
overview: On a rare day off, a mother and her son make the most of their time together, until an unexpected call turns everything upside down.

title: The Last Temptation of Becky
overview: Working as a CIA field agent, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf’s Lair, Hitler’s WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

title: Born in the Jungle
overview: During late 1950s in Venezuela, nine-year-old Elizabeth’s summer break takes a wild turn when her little brother Leo vanishes into the jungle. She must swap her books for bravery not only to find her brother but also to rescue a mystical furry animal from captivity and bring him back up to the legendary Tepui mountain.

title: Tethered
overview: Ayden, a man grappling with a fractured conscience, finds himself at the mercy of a methodical psychiatrist who pushes his unorthodox tactics to the extreme.

title: The Unmaking
overview: Esteemed genius and award-winning arthouse filmmaker Josef Balée's attempt at crafting the most ambitious and pretentious film of his career.

title: Replika
overview: After surviving a horrific car crash and losing his arm, an unstable family man develops a bizarre fascination for augmenting his body with bionic prosthetics.

title: Strange Egg
overview: After moving to a farmhouse with her newly single mother and leaving her father behind, a teenage girl's curiosity awakens something strange within her, forcing a confrontation with her emerging desires.

title: K-Pop Shark Heroes
overview: Follows Ken Jeong and Rei Ami as they launch a public awareness campaign to reshape the perception of sharks across East Asia using K-Pop after shark encounters off the Korean Peninsula.

title: KING
overview: King, a champion of the fighting organization, lives, trains, and fights under one roof with his roommate Sam. They compete weekly in grueling matches that leave them bruised and battered. Their landlord and promoter promises to get them away from this lifestyle for bigger and better opportunities on the condition that they continue to push themselves for another fight. The roommates face their toughest battles during recovery while pushing each other to continue training for their next bouts.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: GEMINI
overview: GEMINI is a darkly comedic and intimate portrait of love, loss, and secrecy.

title: Tib Tub, We Need You!
overview: Three kids and their best friend Tib Tub, a 30-foot-tall robot boy, have one day left to complete the Perfect Summer Checklist. All they have left to do is go for a swim…without accidentally destroying the whole town!

title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

title: RESET
overview: In a world where citizens are reset to six at age 65, a young woman must care for her newly-reset mother and find her estranged father before the state intervenes— only to discover that healing her family means reparenting the child her mother never got to be.

title: Jurassic Sharks
overview: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).

title: Bagman
overview: A graduate researcher monitoring wildlife cameras notices a garbage bag suddenly appear in a forest clearing. She sends her senior technician to check it out--watching his every move through the live camera feed.

title: The Devil's Mouth
overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

title: Above & Below
overview: A group of friends set off for an unforgettable vacation. What begins as an adventure of partying and diving quickly turns into a nightmare when they are attacked by criminals in open waters.

title: God Hunter
overview: In a world where beings from myth and folklore have entered our realm, an undercover cop infiltrates a trafficking ring that smuggles and sells these beings to find his son.

title: Redemptions
overview: Marcel, a retired hitman, is forced back into action and commits two murders in Montreal. In doing so, he unwittingly sets in motion a chain of unforeseen events that will ultimately endanger the life of his own daughter in Paris.

title: Cattle
overview: A quiet farmer is pushed to the breaking point by a group of teenagers.

title: Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret
overview: An investigative documentary exploring long-standing and newly detailed allegations of sexual misconduct, grooming, and criminal sexual conduct against Oscar-winning actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman Jared Leto.

title: Love/Bug
overview: A couple, affectionately naming each other Love and Bug, test the limits of their love living with each other for fifteen months.

title: Saint Eulalia
overview: Eulàlia, a sixteen-year-old girl with a gift for healing, has always cared for those most in need in the village of Alaior. But lately, the strain of her gift has left her exhausted and alone.

title: Cigarette Smoke
overview: Two places, two kinds of smoke: one cigarette says everything, one vape says nothing at all.

title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

title: A Child of My Own
overview: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

title: Familiar Strangers
overview: A short drama exploring how different people deal with grief.

title: Akal Imitasi
overview: Set in the year 2029, the story focuses on an AI-based system called PIKO in schools, and how this technology widens the gap and leads to the loss of the true essence of learning.

title: Afterliving
overview: A woman arrives at The Bureau, a mysterious in-between, where her life is put to a test before her fate can be decided.

title: Chasing Home
overview: A 30-year-old British-Mexican comic creator visits her parents to secure a deposit for her first flat, only to find help won’t come because her mother, 51, is pregnant.

title: The Fabulous Time Machine
overview: What if it were possible to travel back in time to dream of other futures? In the hinterlands of Brazil, young girls navigate the delicate transition from childhood to adolescence while grappling with social media, religion, their dreams, and the stories of the women who came before them. By inventing a time machine, they revisit the pasts of their mothers and grandmothers and imagine a future in which they can be free, fulfilled, and in control of their own choices.

title: Ashes
overview: One night. One gun. Two estranged brothers reunited by the man who killed their parents and a choice that will either damn them both or lead one to grace.

title: The Elder Eagle
overview: The old man refuses to leave his native village, abandoned by other residents long time ago. To stand up to the local authorities, who have their own plans for the beautiful mountain land, he lures by deceit his son and grandchildren from Moscow – they must help him turn the village into an eco-touristic place. The family members get a chance to reconnect with their roots, see each other in a new light, and become a close, loving family.

title: Hierophany
overview: An extraterrestrial-obsessed man is troubled by nightly visitations from a mysterious presence.

title: Simon Says
overview: A group of friends gathers for a party when a mysterious entertainer named Simon arrives to host a game of Simon Says. What begins as a harmless game becomes a deadly fight for survival, where one wrong move can cost them their lives.

title: Nova '78
overview: Resurrected through UK-led archival restoration NOVA 78' shows never-before-seen footage of the legendary Nova Convention where William Burroughs, Patti Smith, Zappa, Ginsberg and more collided in an explosion of ideas, art and rebellion.

title: Encore, encore...
overview: On the last night of his closing Cambodian restaurant, Pou struggles to accept his career is coming to an end.

title: Tiny Rejections
overview: Taylor and her friend try to climb a fence at night but something looms in the shadows.

title: AMUCK
overview: A man who laments "not even feeling like the main character of his own story" suddenly finds himself aware of the camera that's watching him, eliciting a mind-bending journey of self discovery.

title: Fuga 22
overview: A snappy and hyper-saturated ode and eulogy to growing up in Tegucigalpa, Honduras, and immigrating to Canada. A slice of life through the lens of a camcorder.

title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
overview: When the fairytale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

title: Margeado
overview: The river is not the same. It has turned into contaminated mud. Residents of a fishing village face an uncertain future after the dam burst. Yara and Dingue resume their lives, remain and drift in the memory of the place while the waters run down the mountains in the face of the indomitable forces of nature.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

title: Crayon Shin-chan the Movie: Very Bizarre! My Yokai Vacation
overview: Shin-chan and his family visit his father's home town of Akita in order to view the Omagari Fireworks Festival. When a strange incident to causes the residents of “Yokai Land” to begin running wild throughout Akita and the rest of Japan, Shin-chan and company are lured to “Yokai Land” for an unusual adventure.

title: I Want Your Sex
overview: When fresh-faced Elliot lands an exciting job for renowned artist, icon and provocateur Erika Tracy, his fantasies come true as Erika taps him to become her sexual muse. But Elliot soon finds himself out of his depth as Erika takes him on a journey more profound than he ever could have imagined, into a world of sex, obsession, power, betrayal and murder.

title: Gatta Kusthi 2
overview: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

title: The Gentleman Thief
overview: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

title: Maaran
overview: In a patriarchal society, two strangers - Birwa, a trafficking survivor, and Tara, who faces the same fate - are drawn into the path of a ruthless predator. Maaran exposes the devastating impact of gender-based violence and oppression.

title: Obsess
overview: Lucy Bel, a literary icon and woman of power, sees her empire threatened by an admirer whose fascination turns into obsession. When admiration is no longer enough, becoming her becomes a necessity. How far must one go to stay on top?

title: DON'DUT
overview: Aflah and his team began working on a personal documentary about Aflah challenging himself to lose weight. But as time went on, his goals began to crumble, his diet slowly lost focus, while Aflah’s desire to control the direction of the film only grew stronger. His team began to question whether this documentary was truly about change, or simply about Aflah wanting to make himself the center of the story.

title: Rao Bahadur
overview: In 1970s India, an eccentric aristocrat—labeled a 'man of miracles'—miraculously survives a terminal illness. Plagued by guilt and fear, he retreats into his palatial mansion, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

title: Unmadham
overview: A police constable reopens a long-forgotten case and experiences an unsettling world.

title: GALAXIES
overview: An aimless weed dealer has all of his product stolen along with his beloved Nike Galaxy Foamposites.

title: Bad Beast
overview: An orphaned girl named Atenea lives in isolation with other children. When adopted by a family, she glimpses a chance at belonging, but her fear of losing this newfound home drives her to extreme measures.

title: Summer '16
overview: Set during the summer of 2016, Jared's world shifts when his best friend, Bando, lands his first job—forcing Jared to confront the one thing he's been avoiding: growing up.

title: Transylvania Tapes
overview: In 1997, Romanian actress Silvia Enescu mysteriously disappeared while searching for family property in Transylvania. All she left behind were a collection of home movies: the TRANSYLVANIA TAPES. Now, Silvia's daughter Mara travels from Los Angeles to Romania to discover what happened to her mother. With the help of her cameraman friend Dylan, Mara documents her journey, which takes her from the streets of Bucharest to the medieval town of Sighisoara, deep in the heart of Transylvania. Unearthing the truth about her mother comes at a terrible price, as Mara must escape an ancient family curse.

title: Villain
overview: Home for winter break, Clyde asks his estranged brother, Sean, to reunite with the family for Christmas Eve dinner. The table is set, and still, no response.

title: Lost Men
overview: My grandfather, married for 57 years in Costa Rica, died in a fire in 2019. My father revealed to me that, like myself, my grandfather was gay. After this revelation, together we revisit my grandfather's life, seeking to give him one last act of liberation while discovering ourselves in the process.

title: La Chandleur
overview: Albert, a young man in his twenties, lives alone in his grandfather's country house under one condition: he must take care of the farm animals. While getting ready for a date, he discovers that a fox has attacked the ducks in the coop. Determined to protect the last surviving goose, Albert cancels his dinner and spends the night waiting for the animal. But he realizes that what he is hunting is not just a simple fox, but a far more terrifying entity: the Chandleur.

title: Molder Man
overview: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

title: Atelo
overview: After a brutal race, Damian and Amelia attempt to escape with the blood money they stole.

title: Bakom Svärtan
overview: Go behind the scenes of the TV series *Svärtan*. It follows a group of young people who discover an injured mermaid on an island in the archipelago. The series is based on the book *Sommaren 1985* by John Ajvide Lindqvist, a master at blending Swedish realism with the supernatural. Behind the scenes, an intensive effort is underway to create the mermaid and make her look authentic.

title: HANDMEDOWN
overview: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

title: The Secret Battlefield
overview: In April 1941, months before the Pacific War begins, Japan’s brightest young elites, bureaucrats, military officers, and civilians, are secretly assembled at the Total War Research Institute. Tasked with simulating a conflict against the United States, they confront harsh realities through intense analysis.
